title: Supreme Court orders status quo on Karnataka HC direction to revisit ethanol allocation after BPCL says it will affect E20 fuel programme
description: In a major relief to oil marketing companies (OMCs) and a shot in the arm for Central government's E20 fuel programme, the Supreme Court on Tuesday ordered status quo with respect to the Karnataka High Court direction to OMCs to revisit the distribution of ethanol for the 2025–26 supply year.The Court was hearing a plea filed by Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) challenging a June 2026 Karnataka High Court order.BPCL, represented by Attorney General R Venkataramani, argued that reopeni
